title: Change step outcome
description: The structured outcome a step of an OpenSpec change ends with: an unattended run's last turn, or what an interactive run records through run_change_step.py record. Contract: openspec/specs/change-workflow/spec.md.

outcome.description: finished: the step is done; question: the owner must answer before the step goes on; returned: the step proposes a return to an earlier phase; blocked: the step cannot go on until another change lands; stopped: the step could not go on, for a reason that is not a question.

message.description: What the step says to the owner, shown as it is.

next.description: finished and returned: the exit the step takes, as a target naming a node of the workflow graph — its step; kind for a review, and for a triage the kind of review it triages; sections for an implementation out of the plan's order, as rounds names them; for a validation the target it is for; {"step": "done"} once archive cleanup has run. A return names the step it returns to: {"step": "design"}, {"step": "plan"}, or, from closeout, implementation's {"step": "round"}. What the step says of what follows goes in message.

triaged.description: triage, finished or returned: the records the triage triaged, each named as its file is without .md, NN-<kind> — the reviews, and any validation, owner's notes, or orchestrator's observations triaged with them; each has its triage file beside it, and at least one is a review.

awaiting.description: question: what the step waits for from the owner.

evidence.description: returned: where the evidence for the return is recorded.

blocked_on.description: blocked: the change this one waits on.

reason.description: stopped: why the step could not go on.

rounds.description: finished, from planning: how the plan's sections are implemented, as the design's cadence gives it — a list of rounds, each a list of sessions, each a list of the section ids that session implements, in order; [[[1, 2]], [[3], [4]]] is a round of sections 1 and 2 in one session, then a round of 3 and 4 in a session each.

denials.description: Any outcome: the tool calls the run was denied, as the run's own record lists them, each with the harness's reason; the wrapper sets this on every outcome, and it is required on stopped.
